orchestration_findings.topic: W7 G7.5 CORRECTION - not a gate defect; it is an in-scope implementation fix
orchestration_findings.fact: The orchestrator parsed the Apk Signing Block of the W7 artifact read-only. (1) Signer #1 uses signature algorithm id 0x0104 = RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA2-512, 512-byte signature: DETERMINISTIC, no PSS salt. The implementer report's randomization theory was wrong. (2) The block holds exactly three id-value pairs: v2 (2570 B value at offsets 1306136..1308706), AGP DEPENDENCY METADATA id 0x504b4453 (344 B value at 1308718..1309062), verity padding (1114 B). The implementer's measured differing range 1308724..1309062 lies entirely inside the AGP dependency-metadata value (its last 338 bytes), and the whole v2 signature block was byte-identical between builds. AGP encrypts that metadata block with a random session key per build - the real drift source. (3) A second drift source: three source maps ship inside the APK (index-*.js.map 1707300 B, sw.js.map 3599 B, workbox-*.js.map 147250 B); sw.js.map has a random per-build temp dir in sources and embeds absolute worktree paths, so the APK hash also depends on the worktree path - which would make GC.12 fail on the integration tree even with a deterministic signature. Both sources are packaging decisions inside W7 allowed scope apps/mobile/**: `dependenciesInfo { includeInApk = false; includeInBundle = false }` plus excluding **/*.map from the syncRemoteWebAssets task. Repair iteration 1 was dispatched to prove byte-identical rebuilds before recording any hash. Consequence: G7.5 is satisfiable without editing any gate, and the G7.5 item is removed from the owner-decision list.
